regime.detail: Stocks are falling while Treasury yields fall, so money is moving into bonds.

read: The S&P 500 fell 0.5% on Tuesday, Nov 24 and fell 1.9% over the past week. The VIX closed at 26.4.
Over the week, the 10-year yield fell 20 bp to 4.90%, oil fell 5.3%, gold fell 8.1%, the dollar rose 0.3%, and chip stocks fell 7.2%.
Strongest sector this week: Consumer discretionary (+0.5%). Weakest: Semiconductors (−7.2%).
The biggest news themes right now: AI & chips, Inflation, jobs & economy, Banks & credit.
